text.card: A red giant 2,182 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.01 solar masses and 6.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,806 K at its surface.
